backend/main.mo: Defines story, comment, and user profile types with access control, submission, commenting, moderation, and profile management APIs.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries detailing related files, components, tests, and confidence levels for two implemented features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries for multiple frontend files used as reference metadata.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide stub outlining instructions for deploying the application on the Internet Computer.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS base layers and extensive OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting the document title and loading the React application root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes and wraps the app in AppLayout.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedStat: Displays an access‑denied message with navigation back to the stories page.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Renders the main site header with navigation links and a submit‑story action button.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Provides global layout with header, content container, and footer containing About and Troubleshooting links.
Comment submission form that posts new comments via mutation and handles basic validation and errors.
frontend/src/components/CommentThread.ts: Displays a list of comments for a story with loading, empty, and error fallback states using useGetComments.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Provides admin hooks to fetch all stories and publish moderated stories, invalidating related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity provider and hook for login, logout, and identity persistence using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useStories.ts: Offers hooks for fetching published stories, individual stories, submitting stories, and adding comments, with placeholder comment retrieval.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles, color themes, typography, and UI state styling for the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders an About page describing the author and providing contact details.
frontend/src/pages/AdminModerationPage.t: Admin interface for reviewing, editing, and publishing submitted stories with loading, error, and unauthorized states.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Displays a hero section and a feed of published stories with loading, error, and empty states using useGetPublishedStories.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with a hero section and feature cards, offering navigation to the stories feed or story submission.
frontend/src/pages/StoryDetailPage.tsx: Shows a full story with metadata, loading/error states, and a comments section fetched via useGetPublishedStory.
frontend/src/pages/SubmitStoryPage.tsx: Provides a form for submitting a story with optional anonymity, handles submission state, and shows a confirmation screen.
frontend/src/pages/TroubleshootingPage.t: Explains canister resolution issues and displays copyable canister URLs using getCanisterUrls.
frontend/src/utils/canisterUrls.ts: Generates backend canister IDs and constructs standard and raw ICP URLs for troubleshooting.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routes), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, animations, and plugins for container queries and animation utilities.
project_state.json: Describes the project's current state, known issues, and existing features related to deployment troubleshooting and redeploy guidance.
